definition: Constructs, expands or equips a facility designed to host shared computing, storage or network services.
Upgrades or consolidates existing datacenters or server rooms to improve capacity, reliability, efficiency or manageability.
Provides racks, structured cabling, power distribution, UPS, generators, cooling, fire suppression, monitoring or physical access controls.
Introduces DCIM, operating procedures, staffing, maintenance, capacity planning, service management or energy monitoring.
Procures third-party datacenter space or managed hosting with defined facility and service requirements.
